reason: The hypothesis makes specific claims about oxide formation, barrier properties, and corrosion mechanisms on boride-based materials, but no prior evidence is cited to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover the specific behavior of boride oxides in molten aluminum, so the lack of citations leaves all key premises unsupported.
premises: Pre-oxidation of borides forms a stable, adherent oxide layer
The oxide layer acts as a diffusion barrier against molten aluminum
The oxide layer reduces interfacial reactions and aluminum penetration
